text:
nina-partnerships: Kickoff thread for NimbusCo marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners: cloud onboarding artifacts, legal addendum (KMS rotation + audit window), SKU packaging, staging demo, and go-to-market collateral. Short volunteers?

ocean-cloud: I can cover cloud artifacts+examples. Will produce: AWS AssumeRole sample, GCP SA impersonation, Azure role assignment. Target: Tue EOD.

harry-legal: I'll draft the marketplace addendum. Please drop exact SKU strings into thread by Monday so I can reference them. Also clarifying: Nimbus requested 90-day KMS rotation language.

mira-product: Will own SKU mapping + pricing tiers. Proposing: ["nimbus-core", "nimbus-dedicated", "nimbus-private-trial"]. Will upload CSV.

jin-ops: Trials require metadata: duration, seats, auto-expire flag. Confirming support contact and telemetry consent from partner.

pat-eng: I'll make staging screenshots and a quick 60s demo. Need staging publisher account creds.

nina-partnerships: I'll request staging creds from Nimbus PM and post secure link. Also partners want a co-branded blog + webinar; recommend gating public launch on legal sign-off + staging pass.

ocean-cloud: Sample AWS assume snippet:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/NimbusPublisher"}]}
```

harry-legal: If SKUs land Mon, I can finish draft by Thu COB. Will include KMS rotation clause and audit log access window.

mira-product: CSV uploaded. SKU strings: ["nimbus-core","nimbus-dedicated","nimbus-private-trial"].

jin-ops: Partner okayed anonymized telemetry. Support email: support@nimbus.example. Adding to manifest.

ci-bot: Created doc: /docs/marketplace/nimbus-onboard-manifest-v1.md

nina-partnerships: Thanks all. Sync scheduled Wed 10:00am to check PRs and legal draft. Action items: @ocean-cloud -> cloud templates; @mira-product -> confirm pricing tiers; @harry-legal -> amendment draft; @pat-eng -> staging assets. :thumbsup:
